scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @opc/shared build && pnpm --filter @opc/server build && pnpm --filter @opc/cli build && pnpm --filter @opc/web build
scripts.build:electron: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:runtime-bundles && node scripts/verify-server-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-cli-bundle.mjs && cd electron-app && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.stage:runtime-bundles: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('electron-app/server-bundle',{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm --filter @opc/server --legacy --config.node-linker=hoisted deploy --prod electron-app/server-bundle && node scripts/stage-cli-runtime.mjs && node scripts/stage-node-runtime.mjs
